evidence_quotes.walkthrough_trigger: Well, you know, what typically for homes this size it is best estimated if we can do a virtual walkthrough like we're going to jump into a video call and then you can walk us through the house. Is that something you have availability for?

top_strength: Jules correctly identified that the 2400 sq ft two-story home warrants a virtual walkthrough and cleanly routed to it, securing the customer's availability and confirming details (address, move date, square footage, bedrooms, new address) before handing off.
coaching_note: Jules never asked the two-concerns question (reliability/damage) or delivered the Two Promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) that should land before probing—these need to happen in the first 2-3 minutes on every call, including walkthrough-scheduler calls, because Step 3 now scores on all call types.
